en: An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large brick high school building with a prominent tower and arched entrance. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century American, with tall windows and a square clock‑tower–like structure. In the foreground a group of boys and young men in period clothing stand or pose on the lawn. Mature trees partially obscure the building. Handwritten catalog numbers appear at the top right.
